summary.text: Michael Cahill is a Democratic state representative from Rockingham 10 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A computer technician, he has served in the House since 2012.

paragraphs.text: Michael Cahill's career experience includes working as a computer technician.

Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2012, and he served on the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee from the 2013-2014 session through 2023-2024.
